# dsh.pub

> Source-backed directory and development guide for the DeepSeek Harness plugin ecosystem.

## Agent guide

- [Develop a DeepSeek Harness plugin](https://dsh.pub/develop-plugin.md): Agent-first contract for
  building Host plugins, Web UI clients, independently installable bundle layers, verification, and
  dsh.pub catalog admission. Read the target repository's own Agent instructions first.

## Catalog

- [Plugin search API](https://dsh.pub/api/plugins?q=web+search): Query the registry server-side and
  receive only matching entries with their commit-pinned install commands. Preferred for Agent-side
  search. Supports `q`, `category`, `type`, `installable`, `builtIn`, `limit`, and `offset`.
- [Machine-readable plugin index](https://dsh.pub/plugins.json): Complete static JSON for Agent-side
  search across Registry records and discovery-only ecosystem candidates. Several megabytes — prefer
  the search API and avoid loading it whole.
- [English plugin catalog](https://dsh.pub/en/plugins/): Built-in and source-reviewed community
  capabilities.
- [中文插件目录](https://dsh.pub/zh/plugins/): 内置插件与经过源码契约核对的社区插件。

## Provenance

- [DeepSeek Harness source](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
- [dsh.pub source](https://github.com/dsh-pub/dsh-pub)
